definitions.explanation: A word that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another word. A standard linguistics and language-learning term.

examples.japanese: 「{大|おお}きい」の{類義語|るいぎご}は「{巨大|きょだい}」です。
{類義語|るいぎご}の{使|つか}い{分|わ}けが{難|むずか}しい。
{辞書|じしょ}で{類義語|るいぎご}を{調|しら}べて、{微妙|びみょう}なニュアンスの{違|ちが}いを{理解|りかい}した。
examples.english: I looked up synonyms in the dictionary and understood the subtle differences in nuance.

notes:
USAGE:
{類義語|るいぎご} is the standard term used in language education and linguistics. It appears frequently in textbooks, dictionaries, and language exams.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {類義語|るいぎご}{辞典|じてん} (thesaurus, synonym dictionary)
- {類義語|るいぎご}の{使|つか}い{分|わ}け (distinguishing between synonyms)
- {類義語|るいぎご}を{調|しら}べる (to look up synonyms)

RELATED WORDS:
{対義語|たいぎご} means antonym. {同義語|どうぎご} means a word with exactly the same meaning, while {類義語|るいぎご} includes words with similar but not identical meanings.
